sources.title: Labor market impacts of AI: A new measure and early evidence
sources.snippet: In this paper, we present a new framework for understanding AI's labor market impacts, and test it against early data, finding limited evidence that AI has affected employment to date. Our goal is to establish an approach for measuring how AI is affecting employment, and to revisit these analyses periodically.
